title: P16 security and parity exit
objective: Qualify the COTRA-P16 exit using a pinned, provenance-recorded source audit of Desktop Commander (wonderwhy-er/DesktopCommanderMCP) and the founder-authorized Kernux source pool as evidence input: build a parity matrix classifying every major Desktop Commander-class workflow as COTRA_NATIVE, COTRA_SUPERIOR, DONOR_ADAPTED, SAFE_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED, or INTENTIONALLY_DENIED, and a donor reuse matrix classifying each candidate subsystem as REUSE_VERBATIM, ADAPT, PORT, REFERENCE_ONLY, or REJECT_FOR_COTRA with exact revisions, paths, obligations, and authority deltas; prove that the intended everyday local development and workstation workflows run end to end through Cotra's own MCP surface and kernel; record every deliberately denied authority as a security decision; prove with regression tests that no unrestricted shell, PowerShell or cmd, generic socket, silent elevation, remote approval, or model self-approval path exists; confirm the profiles are exact; fix every defect at its root; and record the P16 exit. Donor capabilities that would add authority are recorded for lawful successor grains, never imported here.

include: a pinned source audit of Desktop Commander and the Kernux source pool (Kernux donor maps and the sources they reference) producing a parity matrix and a donor reuse matrix with exact revisions, source paths, Cotra destinations, license and dependency obligations, authority deltas, and reasons

an end-to-end workflow suite over the authoritative MCP builder and the real cotrad dispatch for every workflow the parity inventory marks exposed, using the test approval broker for approval-bound steps and real Windows where behavior is Windows-specific
a Desktop Commander replacement record mapping each Desktop Commander-class capability to its Cotra tool, its documented security denial, or its explicit out-of-target status

source and behavior regression tests proving no unrestricted shell, PowerShell or cmd interpreter launch, generic socket or proxy, silent elevation, remote approval, or model self-approval path exists in shipped sources
confirmation that the core and desktop_structured profiles and the parity inventory agree exactly with the shipped catalog
root-cause fixes for any defect found and the COTRA-P16 exit record
exclude: importing donor code that adds authority; such candidates are recorded as SAFE_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED for a lawful successor grain
any new tool, kernel shape, scope, profile, or authority

invariants: no unrestricted shell, PowerShell, cmd, generic socket, silent elevation, or remote approval exists
deliberately denied authority is recorded as a security decision, never as a missing feature
public and local profiles are exact and regression-tested

acceptance.claim: Every exposed everyday development and workstation workflow runs end to end through Cotra's MCP surface and kernel, and the pinned parity matrix classifies every major Desktop Commander-class workflow as COTRA_NATIVE, COTRA_SUPERIOR, DONOR_ADAPTED, SAFE_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED, or INTENTIONALLY_DENIED with a stated reason, alongside a donor reuse matrix with exact revisions and obligations.

Regression tests prove no unrestricted shell, PowerShell or cmd, generic socket or proxy, silent elevation, remote approval, or model self-approval path exists, and the public and local profiles equal the shipped catalog exactly.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000067: COTRA-P17 provider distribution may proceed only after SG-000066 closes and COTRA-P16 is exited canonically.

done_when: COTRA-P16 is exited canonically with workflow, denial, and profile evidence and every defect fixed at its root.
